entities.name: CoaBC query homolog
observations: 400-aa sequence; best reviewed Swiss-Prot matches are CoaBC proteins at 46–49% identity and about 96–99% query coverage.

Homolog annotations assign two sequential CoA-biosynthesis activities: phosphopantothenoylcysteine synthesis and decarboxylation to phosphopantetheine; inference for query, not direct experimental verification.
Homologs list FMN and Mg2+ as cofactors.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenoylcysteine synthesis
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:19397; EC 6.3.2.5.

entities.name: Phosphopantetheine decarboxylation
observations: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H+ → (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2; Rhea RHEA:16793; EC 4.1.1.36.
